newsitem.title: USA: DMI Furniture sees Q1 EPS above $0.13.
newsitem.headline: DMI Furniture sees Q1 EPS above $0.13.

text.p: DMI Furniture Inc Thursday said it expects to report net income in excess of $750,000, or more than $0.13 per share, for the first quarter of its 1997 fiscal year, ending November 30, 1996.
DMI expects net sales to total approximately $15.8 million in quarter, compared with $17.7 million a year earlier.

DMI recorded a net loss of $184,000, or $0.06 per share, in the first quarter of fiscal 1996, which ended on December 2, 1995. In that period, the company set aside $995,000 for a plant closing reserve as part of its asset consolidation and redeployment program.
About $118,000 of this reserve, or $0.01 per share, will be recovered from this reserve and included in operating profit for the 1997 first quarter, the company said.
